description.zh: 待添加的共享设备名称。
description.en: The device name of the device to be added.

description.zh: 待添加共享设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。
description.en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device to be added belongs.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
促销活动ID。

调用接口**CreateSharePromotionActivity**返回的**Data**值。
description.en:
The ID of the promotion activity.  

This value is the **Data** field returned by calling the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** API.

description.zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见[使用共享设备播报分享语料](~~607661~~)。
description.en:
The share code of the sharing task.  

For information about the share code of a sharing task, see [Use shared devices to broadcast sharing scripts](~~607661~~).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
促销活动使用的详细说明，请参见**CreateSharePromotionActivity**接口文档的**使用说明**。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为3。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
For detailed instructions on using sales promotion activities, see the **How-To** section in the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** API documentation.

## queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 3.

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot add-device-to-share-promotion --share-promotion-activity-id 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --share-task-code 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-cv300000000 --device-simple-info-list ProductKey=a2YwD20000 DeviceName=device01 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot AddDeviceToSharePromotion --region cn-hangzhou --ShareTaskCode 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot-cv300000000' --SharePromotionActivityId 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --DeviceSimpleInfoList.1.DeviceName device01 --DeviceSimpleInfoList.1.ProductKey a2YwD20000
